Geolocation._comment: Permission strings are injected into Info.plist / AndroidManifest.xml when 'npx cap add ios|android' runs. Apple rejects apps whose location purpose string is vague, so this states the actual use.
Geolocation.iosLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: ROOTED uses your location to show verified farms, farmers markets, CSAs and grocery stores near you on the Local Food Map.
